business_summary: Kyoto Tool Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive maintenance tools, medical tools and related equipment, electrical tools, and other general tools in Japan. It operates in two segments, Tool Business and Facility Management Business. The company also offers ratchet handle and compact head ratchet, as well as wooden grip screwdriver set. It sells its products under the nepros brand through online store. In addition, the company engages in the leasing of real estate; and sale of electricity generated by solar power generation. Kyoto Tool Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kuse, Japan.
